==Summary==

:{{pov|[[Perrin Aybara]]}}
Perrin rides with a group of soldiers whose task is to attract the attention of the [[Trolloc|Trollocs]] outside Caemlyn and make them follow the humans to the woods. The soldiers attack the [[Shadowspawn]] with arrows but they do not break from their position outside the city walls. Perrin declares they will continue attacking until the Trollocs follow.

:{{pov|[[Elayne Trakand]]}}
Elayne is updated on Perrin's progress during the day. The Queen decides she will hop through a [[Gateways|gateway]] and see for herself how the fight is going. [[Birgitte Silverbow|Birgitte]], holding the copy of the [[Silver foxhead medallion|foxhead medallion]] Elayne made, threatens to carry her back on her shoulder if she dares going to Perrin. The Queen gives up her plan.

She meets [[Uno Nomesta|Uno]] who is serving as [[Egwene al'Vere|Egwene]]'s messenger. Elayne manages to catch her [[Warder]] watching the old soldier. Amused at Birgitte's lustful thoughts, she enters her command tent. She is updated on the battles at the other three fronts and is upset by the situation in [[Tarwin's Gap]]. She realizes they need to win swiftly in [[Andor]] so they could help the other armies. She insists on hitting the Trollocs harder and using the dragons if they retreat back into the city.

:{{pov|[[Androl Genhald]]}}
Androl wakes, tied up and unable to channel due to the [[forkroot]] he's been dosed with. The [[Dreadlords]] have been working on [[Algarin Pendaloan|Emarin]], and though he hasn't [[Turning|Turned]], he seems closer to breaking. [[Mazrim Taim|Taim's]] thirteen Dreadlords are exhausted. [[Pevara Tazanovni|Pevara]] has also been dosed with forkroot and is unconscious. Taim was angry when he found out his men gave it to her because he wanted to Turn Pevara next, and a person who can't channel, even temporarily, can't be Turned. 

[[Toveine Gazal|Toveine]] is brought in and gagged. Though Taim usually watches the turning, now he fondles [[Seven Seals|a seal to the Dark One's prison]]{{Ref|It is unclear when and how the seals were stolen.}}. Then he tells [[Atal Mishraile|Mishraile]] that it's time and orders him to follow. Taim tells the thirteen [[Asha'man]] that he wants Toveine Turned by the time he returns. 

:{{pov|[[Al'Lan Mandragoran]]}}
Lan rides toward the Gap when he hears explosions - enemy channelers. [[Jahar Narishma|Narishma]], with [[Merise Haindehl|his Aes Sedai]], estimates their number at around two dozen. Lan admits they need to retreat and sends Narishma to Elayne in order to bring more channelers to cover their retreat. The Gap is lost, as is Malkier, for the second time and it's like a knife twisting in Lan's heart. 

:{{pov|[[Elayne Trakand]]}}
Elayne is waiting inside Braem Wood. She remembers a tale about Birgitte leading a band of thieves in the same forest. Birgitte is able to confirm the tale, though her memories are continuing to fade.  

A messenger from Caemlyn arrives informing the Queen that Perrin has successfully engaged the Trollocs. The soldiers in the wood begin to prepare themselves. Perrin's soldiers finally reach Braem Wood, the Trollocs close behind them. The archers loose their arrows taking down many of the Shadowspawn's archers. Elayne's forces lure the Trollocs further into the woods. They succeed and use the cover the trees provide to take down even more Trollocs using explosives, more arrows and dragons. The result is impressive. Elayne and Birgitte argue over the dragons. Elayne states that nobody but Trollocs would go against such weapons. Birgitte doesn't think that's a good thing. Warfare has changed forever.
